999008199.text:
さて、コウセンの謀反から数日経ち……
ようやく落ち着くこともできた

localizations.en: Well, it's been several days since Kosen's rebellion... and we can finally rest easy.

999008199.text:
遅くなったが礼を言わせてほしい。助けてくれて……
ありがとう、千歳、永遠、鬼門……それに異国人たちよ

localizations.en: I'm late in saying this, but I want to thank you. For saving us... Thank you, Chitose, Towa, Kimon... and you people from distant lands.

999008199.text:
あ、ありがたきお言葉！
こ、幸甚にじょ……存じます！

localizations.en: Such gracious words! We are... deeply honored!

999008199.text:
ふふっ、そう畏まらずともよい。
今日は宴、無礼講といこうではないか

localizations.en: No need to be so formal. Today is a feast—let's keep things casual, shall we?

999008199.text: お前はいつも無礼講だと思うけどねぇ

localizations.en: Do you ever take things seriously?

999008199.text: はっはっは、違いない！

しかし別世界の者を登用し、ララ・キングダムなる国と
誼を結ぶ……神聖国はいい人材を揃えているな

localizations.en: But recruiting people from other worlds and forming ties with something called the Kingdom of Lara... Nova has assembled quite the talented individuals.

999008199.text:
（別にララ・キングダムとは国交ないんだけど
　説明するとややこしくなるから黙っとこう）

localizations.en: (We don't actually have diplomatic relations with the Kingdom of Lara, but explaining that would just complicate things, so I'll keep quiet.)

999008199.text:
そちらの二人……レスナとヴァレリアといったか。
お前たちが噂の異世界から来た錬金術士か？

localizations.en: You two there... Resna and Valeria, was it? So you're the rumored alchemists from another world?

999008199.text: いえ、私たちはランターナ王国の人間です

localizations.en: No, we're from the Kingdom of Lantarna.

999008199.text:
ほう、ランターナといえばあの大海の遥か先、
南東に鎮座する大陸ではないか

localizations.en: Ah, Lantarna—that great continent sitting far across the ocean to the southeast, isn't it?

999008199.text:
遠洋を航海する技術も擁しているとは……
相手にとって不足はないな！

localizations.en: To think you also possess the technology for ocean voyages... you'd make worthy opponents!

999008199.text: ちょっと、その発言危ないわよ

localizations.en: Hey, that could be misconstrued as a threat.

999008199.text:
はっはっは、冗談だ。今はその時ではあるまい。
まずは領内の平穏を取り戻すのが最優先だ

localizations.en: Hahaha, just joking. Now isn't the time for that. Restoring peace to my domain comes first.

999008199.text:
（今は、って……本当に元から野心家なんだわ。
　そりゃつけこまれるわけね）

localizations.en: (Now isn't the time...? She really was ambitious from the start. No wonder she was so easily exploited.)

999008199.text:
余は中央に反旗を翻し、ケイウン全土の掌握を
確かに企んでいた……だが、幸いにも企みの段階だった

localizations.en: I did indeed rebel against the central authority and scheme to seize control of all of Keiun... but fortunately, it never moved beyond the planning stage.

999008199.text:
コウセンについても謀反という形で
内々に処理することができそうだ

localizations.en: As for Kosen, it looks like we can handle his case internally as an act of treason.

999008199.text:
揺れた領内の地盤を固め、民に安寧と平和を
もたらす……でござりまするな

localizations.en: Stabilizing the shaken foundations of the domain and bringing peace and tranquility to the people... that is what matters now.

999008199.text:
ただ、ケイウンは保守的な土地柄で閉じこもりがちだ。
刺激を与える方法を常に模索していきたいと思う

localizations.en: However, Keiun tends to be conservative and insular by nature. I'd like to keep looking for ways to provide stimulation.

999008199.text:
それにまた余が間違ったとしても、
止めてくれる大切な仲間たちがいる。心強い限りだ

localizations.en: And even if I make mistakes again, I have precious companions who will stop me. It's quite reassuring.

999008199.text:
はい、ずっと支え続けてまいります……
あなたの、一番近いところで

localizations.en: Yes, I will continue to support you always... by your side.

999008199.text:
千歳。どれだけ世界が広くても、どれだけ
別の世界が広がろうとも、お前が一番かわいいだろうな

localizations.en: Chitose. No matter how wide the world becomes, no matter what other worlds may unfold, you'll always be the most precious to me.

999008199.text:
ふぅ……ともかく、今回は異国の者たちに
大変な借りができてしまった

localizations.en: Anyway... this time we've incurred a great debt to these people from foreign lands.

999008199.text:
これから、当家はそなたらに力を貸すと
そう約束しよう。余も自ら刀を振るわせてもらう！

localizations.en: From now on, House Doumen pledges to lend you our strength. I'll take up my blade personally!

999008199.text:
ありがたいですけど、その、
領主が国を離れるというのは……

localizations.en: We're grateful, but, um... is it really appropriate for a lord to leave their territory?

999008199.text:
なに、余には弟や妹たちがおる。
名代として管理を一時的に任せることもよくやっておる

localizations.en: What? I have younger brothers and sisters. I often temporarily entrust responsibilities to them as my representatives.

999008199.text:
そうだったんだ！？
なんか勝手に一人娘かと思ってた……

localizations.en: Really?! I somehow assumed you were an only child...

999008199.text:
みんな鏑矢と違って大人しく
聞き分けのいい弟妹たちだよ

localizations.en: They're all much quieter and more well-behaved than Kaburaya.

999008199.text: ところで、お前たちはこの後どうするつもりだ？

localizations.en: By the way, what do you plan to do next?

999008199.text:
大陸から遥々やって来たということは、
何か目的があるのではないか？　話してみろ

localizations.en: Coming all this way from the continent must mean you have some purpose, doesn't it? Tell me about it.

999008199.text: はい。実は――
